portInfo.description: Castaway Cay’s useful planning unit is an activity area, not a list of public monuments. The family beaches, Snorkeling Lagoon, Pelican Plunge, In Da Shade games and Serenity Bay give different groups room to build a day without leaving the island. These are genuine mapped places, but inclusion, staffing and water access still depend on Disney’s operating decisions. The FAQ describes a direct dock and tram service. Personal/electric wheelchairs can be accommodated on trams, but sand wheelchairs are different and a beach surface is not made step-free by a tram ride. Serenity Bay is adults 18+, and the map requires a flotation vest in the Snorkeling Lagoon. No excursion price, all-day buffet hours or guaranteed parasailing programme is invented.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Castaway Family Beaches, Castaway Family Beaches, Castaway Cay; Scuttle’s Cove/Pelican Point tram areas: A family-oriented beach base rather than a rapid circuit. Allow about 150 minutes (editorial estimate). Current swimming flags, lifeguard directions and activity availability govern use.

Snorkeling Lagoon, Snorkeling Lagoon, Castaway Family Beach area, Castaway Cay: A bounded snorkelling option close to the family beach. Allow about 90 minutes (editorial estimate). Flotation vest mandatory per map; gear/inclusions and individual ability require confirmation.

Pelican Plunge, Pelican Plunge, near Pelican Point, Castaway Cay: A mapped water-play alternative to a land excursion. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Height/ability/sea restrictions and current opening must be checked with staff.

In Da Shade Games, In Da Shade game pavilion, Castaway Cay: A lower-transfer land-activity option when you want a break from water. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). No promise that every table/game is staffed or available.

Serenity Bay, Serenity Bay, adults-only beach; tram areaD, Castaway Cay: An 18+ quieter-beach option with its own transport allowance. Allow about 180 minutes (editorial estimate). Adults 18+ only; confirm return tram routing and current services.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask staff for the final tram/boarding instruction and follow the ship’s clock. An island day is still a time-limited port call; access is not guaranteed when weather prevents docking.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Castaway Cay cruise dock — Castaway Cay,Bahamas;arrival approach to Arrival Plaza
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Disney provides trams. The official map labels Kargo Handling(A), Scuttle’s Cove(B), Pelican Point(C) and Serenity Bay(D); check which service/transfer is operating for the chosen area. No guaranteed frequency or on-call accessible vehicle is asserted. The plans reserve 30–60 minutes for first/last walking, trams and the dock approach. These are editorial allowances, not official journey times. Return to the ship’s actual boarding location, not merely the nearest beach tram stop. The island is private; do not assume an independent boat to another Bahamian island or a public overnight stay.
